beats.trigger: ## Lecture: Access is not absorption
beats.got: nothing new

beats.trigger: The two get reported as one number and they are not one thing.
beats.got: Licences issued and licences used are different numbers. Reports mix them up, and so do we.

beats.trigger: The proposal got neither a yes nor a no.
beats.got: A good analysis died because leadership lost interest. That is the story of my three programmes, and it is not a US company.

beats.trigger: Accountability is the part with a name on it, and a name does not travel inside a folder.
beats.got: Someone has to answer for what the agent does, and you cannot copy that person. Governance and finance both care about it.

beats.trigger: Pick the one your teammate's week can take in.
beats.got: Each option costs the receiver something different, and there is no price on any of them.

beats.trigger: Your candidate is not competing with nothing. It is competing with that.
beats.got: The rival is the spreadsheet and the gut call they already use. It is a switching-cost question, and I understand those.

beats.trigger: Have the conversation before you build anything more.
beats.got: Talk to one person before spending anything. That is cheap and I can do it.

beats.trigger: Who gets your context, who gets a skill, who wants only the output, and who would use an @mention?
beats.got: The vocabulary is beyond me. I don't have context or skills to hand out.

beats.trigger: Access is a switch someone flips. Absorption happens in other people's weeks.
beats.got: A summary of what I read. The last line is the one I keep.

beats.trigger: Their answer is the evidence. The plan is still the hypothesis.
beats.got: Evidence over plan. I like that.

beats.got: nothing new

take_homes: Having a licence is not the same as people using it. We report the first number and the money is only earned by the second.
Before sharing or buying anything, ask one person how they do the job today and what would make them switch. Write down who answers for it if it goes wrong.
Name the likely failure and the owner up front, in writing, before the money is spent.

monday.move: Ask my controller how the month-end variance commentary is done today: who writes it, how long it takes, and what she would need to see before she trusted a draft from an agent. No agent yet.
monday.stop_condition: If she says the commentary takes under an hour and nobody reads it, I drop it.
monday.blocker: IT has not approved the tool for finance data. I also still don't know what an agent costs per person per month, and the module never gave a figure.

misconception.why: The point that access is a switch and absorption happens in other people's weeks cut against 'AI is a licence you buy'. The module also never gave a cost, so I am not fully changed. I would still ask what it costs for 40 people.

one_line: The jargon was heavy and there was no cost anywhere, but the idea that access is not adoption is what happened to our last three programmes, and the exercise of testing one person before building anything is cheap and sensible.
